basic_info.description: Welcome to 53-55 Downey Street, a classic 4-unit investment opportunity located in the heart of  San Francisco's desirable Cole Valley neighborhood. This well-maintained property features four  charming one-bedroom units, each with a split bathroom and elegant period details that capture  the historic character of the area. The tenants have use of laundry located in the basement. Fully  occupied and individually metered for gas and electricity, this property offers consistent rental  income with minimal overhead. There are individual water heaters for each unit and a dedicated  storage space. Situated just steps from public transportation, restaurants, and shops, this prime  location ensures strong long-term rental demand. An ideal addition to any investor's portfolio,  priced attractively at $425,000 per unit.
